reflection: These unsigned notes are anchors holding our history while we wait for a reason today or tomorrow to let go of past cycles suspended in salt air and dust motes dancing above floorboards without rain, sea spray yet something preserved still inside walls tasting like shore beyond four waiting boundaries unless chosen willingly by those asking aloud before silence falls over everything around us until next thing arrives ready together!
